name: Dalmatian Islands Environment Foundation grants
summary: Grants for local organisations and bodies running habitat and biodiversity conservation, regenerative land use and resource management projects across the Dalmatian islands, with a focus on capacity building and local participation.
reporting: A final report on the project indicators at the end of the project.

eligibility.rule: Local body, or a non-local one active in the area or an expert, that proves local capacity building or impact

applicant_types.quote: Local non-profit organisations, associations, clubs or unions, social cooperative enterprises and/or other local bodies, including research centres, are all welcome to apply for DIEF grants.

geography.quote: DIEF encourages the implementation of projects across the entire Dalmatian archipelago.

access.quote: All applicants need to complete and submit our application form.

effort.quote: All applicants need to complete and submit our application form.

eligibility.quote: Non-local applicants already active in the area, or experts, may also be eligible for grants and strategic partnerships if they prove that they can offer capacity building to the locals and/or tangible impact through their work on the ground.

documents.quote: Documents required to complete the application: Proof of Legal Status Budget Template (to be uploaded in Section 7 of this application form)

after_award.quote: Please note that at the end of the project, you will be asked to report on these indicators.

reporting.quote: Please note that at the end of the project, you will be asked to report on these indicators.

documents: Project budget on DIEF budget template
